response.sql: WITH per_type AS (SELECT t.tradekind AS tradekind, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM advancedbehavior ab JOIN transactionrecord tr ON ab.translink = tr.transreg JOIN trader t ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg GROUP BY t.tradekind), totals AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total, AVG(cnt) AS avg_cnt FROM per_type), shares AS (SELECT p.tradekind, p.cnt, CAST(p.cnt AS REAL) / tt.total AS share, tt.avg_cnt FROM per_type p CROSS JOIN totals tt) SELECT SUM(cnt) AS combined_count, AVG(share) AS avg_share, AVG(cnt - avg_cnt) AS avg_excess_over_average FROM shares WHERE cnt > avg_cnt
